description: On the tabletop there’s a clear plastic container in the middle, a green rectangular block on the right, a blue box on the left, some cords, and a few small colorful pieces near the front. The right hand moves in from the right to grasp the green block as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward over the clear container, then lowers it into the container and releases; the left hand stays near the blue box without touching anything.
